subject: Packaging options: mid-contract upgrade and feature consolidation
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@healthnova.com>

Cc: ProcureOps <procure@healthnova.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Packaging question: mid-contract upgrade & preserving features

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran the pilot team review and have two packaging questions before we finalize procurement:

1) We may need to bump from Compact to Throughput after month 3 if usage spikes. Is there a straightforward upgrade path mid-contract and how are credits/proration handled on the Redwood side?

2) We use two small add-on features (KV-caching priority and per-route tracing). If we move tiers, can those features be preserved or do they get re-evaluated under the new bundle?

ProcureOps is copied with the procurement timeline — target exec sign by 4/30. Can you outline options so we can decide quickly?

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of ML Platform
HealthNova

--
Attachment: none (will request SOW once packaging decided)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com

Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 10:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging question: mid-contract upgrade & preserving features

Hi Sanjay — great to hear. Quick answers up front, then three concrete options attached for budgeting.

TL;DR:
- Mid-contract upgrades: supported. Two paths — instant upgrade (prorated invoice + immediate capacity) or scheduled upgrade (start of next billing period with credit reserves).
- Feature preservation: KV-caching priority and per-route tracing are available as standalone add-ons. When you upgrade, we can carry the existing add-on entitlements for the remainder of the current term; long-term retention depends on the target tier (throughput tiers include tracing but not the KV premium by default).

Options attached (pricing_matrix.xlsx):
A) Conservative: Stay Compact, add burst credits (short-term scaling). No contract change; pay-as-you-go for burst.
B) Predictable: Move to Throughput now with a 12-month commit. Includes per-route tracing bundled; KV-caching stays as an add-on at a reduced rate.
C) Hybrid: Start Compact + pre-purchased upgrade option (option to flip at month 3 at pre-negotiated rate). If exercised, we credit X% of unused Compact months toward Throughput commitment.

Notes on concessions we can offer on committed deals:
- Early exercise credit (applies to C) up to 25% of unused commit value toward initial Throughput months.
- One-time onboarding credit for pilot customers (SOW discount).

Next steps: I can schedule a 30-minute call to walk through the matrix and tailor the pre-purchase option. If you want to move fast, I can also prepare an SOW draft (attached HealthNova_SOW_v2.pdf) and indicative DocuSign link.

Best,
Kimberly Park

Looping in Ben (me) for commercial approval — good write-up Kim. For the hybrid option (C) I'd propose the following concession structure we can approve without exec sign:

- Exercise credit: 20% of remaining Compact committed value applied to the first 3 months of Throughput.
- Time-limited upgrade window: exercise must be notified 30 days before intended flip; immediate exercise (within 7 days) requires a 10% exercise premium.
- Feature retention: per-route tracing included when moving to Throughput; KV-caching add-on discounted 30% for the first 6 months post-upgrade.

Sanjay — if you confirm appetite for Option C + the above mechanics, Kimberly will prepare a redline SOW and we can route the discount approval through me (I have delegation up to 25% on pilot concessions).
